scenarios.label: Bull
conditions: NTM EPS reaches $13.00 as sales finish near the top of guidance and mature-store traffic improves
Underlying merchandise-margin gains survive the planned H2 value investment
SG&A leverage follows the sales result
The market pays 28.51x NTM P/E, the low end of the disputed historical band
scenarios.joint_probability_basis: Traffic, merchandise margin, and SG&A leverage share an operating-leverage driver, but the 28.51x rerating is a separate condition. The 25% judgment probability deliberately discounts the need for both operating delivery and multiple expansion.

scenarios.label: Bear (cyclical trough)

rating_cap: Maximum Starter Position Only because RF-EQ-001, RF-OBS-001, and RF-DISC-002 form a mechanically triggered High cross-module accounting-integrity mosaic. The components do not prove fraud. No Critical governance, solvency, fraud, accounting, or going-concern verdict-lock fired. The actual Watchlist rating is more conservative than the cap.
variant_perception_summary: The possible edge is that capacity-led growth and a finite refund may be receiving more credit than mature-store traffic and recurring cash generation warrant. The claim is testable in Q3, but the evidence is public and no current peer call or external dataset proves consensus wrong. There is no proven variant perception yet.
what_everyone_knows: Burlington is adding stores quickly, Q2 sales grew 11%, management raised FY2026 guidance, and sell-side coverage is favourable.
what_is_priced_in: At $254.69, the reverse-DCF requires 46.75% annual FCFF growth through FY2030 to $1.641bn or a 13.85% EBIT margin, versus a 7.8% LTM EBIT margin.
what_market_may_be_missing: Q2 growth was mainly capacity-led: 9.4 of 11.0 percentage points came from new and non-comparable stores while transactions were relatively flat. The market may be giving earnings growth credit before store and supply-chain spending is proven in free cash flow.
edge_proof: The next Q3 filing must show the transaction response to the value investment and a refund-excluded margin bridge; the FY2026 filing must then show whether free cash flow and store-cohort returns support the DCF path. If transactions and normalised margin hold while cash conversion improves, the engine's caution is wrong.
killer_risk: The planned H2 value investment fails to lift traffic, leaving more inventory to mark down and weakening sales, margin, cash conversion, and the warranted multiple at the same time.

kill_criteria.comparable_basis: Standalone Q3 FY2026 versus standalone Q3 FY2025, using the company-adjusted basis for margin. The exact conjunction passed Q1 FY2026 but not Q2 FY2026, so it did not fire in both recent periods.
kill_criteria.monitor: Company Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q and earnings call in November 2026; the exact release day is not set.

kill_criteria.condition: Q3 FY2026 sales growth is below 9%, comparable-store sales are below 1%, or adjusted EBIT-margin decline is greater than 80bp.
kill_criteria.comparable_basis: Standalone Q3 FY2026 versus standalone Q3 FY2025. Neither Q1 FY2026 nor Q2 FY2026 would have fired the exact downside test.
kill_criteria.monitor: Company Q3 FY2026 Form 10-Q and earnings call in November 2026.

kill_criteria.condition: FY2026 free cash flow, defined as CFO less total cash capex, is below $0.
kill_criteria.comparable_basis: FY2026 full-year U.S.-GAAP cash flow versus FY2025 on the same CFO-less-total-cash-capex definition. Negative annual FCF fired in FY2024 but not FY2025, so it did not fire in both periods.
kill_criteria.stub_arithmetic: H1 FY2026 CFO of $334.624m less cash capex of $532.384m was negative $197.760m, so H2 must exceed positive $197.760m for FY2026 FCF to finish above zero.

kill_criteria.condition: A filed compliance certificate or debt note discloses a maintenance-covenant breach, or ABL availability is unavailable when needed.
kill_criteria.comparable_basis: Event test against the prior quarterly filing's clean disclosed status; no breach or unavailable ABL was disclosed in either of the last two relevant filings.
kill_criteria.monitor: Each Form 10-Q or Form 10-K debt note and any credit-agreement exhibit or compliance certificate.

kill_criteria.condition: Auditor resignation over a disagreement, qualified or going-concern opinion, material restatement, or material ICFR weakness.
kill_criteria.comparable_basis: FY2026 auditor and ICFR reports versus clean FY2025 and FY2024 annual reports on the same annual basis; the adverse event did not fire in either prior period.
kill_criteria.monitor: SEC current reports and the FY2026 Form 10-K.

forecast_ledger.prediction: Burlington's Q3 FY2026 standalone total-sales growth exceeds 11.0% year over year.
forecast_ledger.evidence_today: Q1 FY2026 sales grew 14%, Q2 grew 11%, and management's Q3 FY2026 guidance is 9-11% versus standalone Q3 FY2025.

forecast_ledger.stock_bearish_trigger: Q3 sales growth is below 9%, comps are below 1%, or adjusted EBIT-margin decline is greater than 80bp.

forecast_ledger.prediction: Burlington's Q3 FY2026 adjusted EBIT-margin decline is within 60-80bp versus standalone Q3 FY2025.

causal_steps: The planned Q3 value investment lowers reported adjusted EBIT margin from the prior-year quarter.

forecast_ledger.confirmation_trigger: The Q3 FY2026 earnings release reports an adjusted EBIT-margin decline of 60-80bp inclusive versus standalone Q3 FY2025.
forecast_ledger.falsification_trigger: The same release reports a decline smaller than 60bp or greater than 80bp; there is no residual outcome.

forecast_ledger.stock_bearish_trigger: The Q3 adjusted EBIT-margin decline is greater than 80bp or the Q4 outlook shows further unplanned deterioration.

red_flags.description: Deloitte has 43-year tenure and historical PCAOB orders from 2007, 2013, and 2018. None was tied to BURL, current audit and ICFR opinions are clean, and the current signing partner is unidentified.
red_flags.rating_impact: Monitoring flag and governance-confidence limit; no issuer-misconduct conclusion or hard lock.

red_flags.description: Six distribution centres handled more than 99% of FY2025 merchandise units, with three in New Jersey and three in Southern California; the current split is not disclosed.
red_flags.rating_impact: Raises execution risk but does not trigger an Avoid-Big-Risks cap.

red_flags.description: Receivables and inventory grew faster than revenue and COGS in FY2025. CFO/EBITDA was 99.2%, DIO fell 3.4 days, and the working-capital cash effect was roughly neutral.
red_flags.rating_impact: Mechanical forensic signal only; it contributes to the mosaic but does not prove uncollected earnings.

red_flags.rating_impact: Mechanical forensic signal only; the aggregate is not a simultaneous loss or one-period cash call.

red_flags.description: RF-EQ-001, RF-OBS-001, and RF-DISC-002 are three distinct tagged problems across earnings, balance-sheet survival, and governance. Each retains its qualifier, and the combination does not prove fraud.

error_defense_evidence.bad base rate: Own-history reversion is excluded as an admissible anchor and sector multiple history is marked Not assessable [analyses/BURL_2026-09-29/valuation/02_multiples-own-history.md, §§1–6; analyses/BURL_2026-09-29/valuation/03_relative-valuation-peers.md, §6].
error_defense_evidence.valuation multiple error: The thesis exposes the 126.94% valid-method spread, gives own-history values no weight, and caps valuation confidence at 55 before reporting 50 [analyses/BURL_2026-09-29/valuation/99_valuation-synthesis.md, §§1–4].
error_defense_evidence.bad causal inference: The Q2 sales bridge prints 9.4pp plus 1.6pp equals 11.0pp with zero residual, while the margin bridge prints 130bp of named drivers against a 100bp result and names the negative 30bp residual [analyses/BURL_2026-09-29/earnings/02_revenue-drivers.md, §§4–7; analyses/BURL_2026-09-29/earnings/03_margin-drivers.md, §§2–5].
error_defense_evidence.false negative: The scenario set preserves the valuation module's $370.63 Bull, a 45.52% upside state, and the dossier presents a full bull steelman [analyses/BURL_2026-09-29/valuation/07_scenario-and-fair-value.md, §§2–6; analyses/BURL_2026-09-29/final_thesis.md, §9A].
error_defense_evidence.timing error: The catalyst module and dossier label the Q3 date as a company-confirmed November window, not a confirmed November 25 release, and separate hard governance dates from the vague operating event [analyses/BURL_2026-09-29/catalyst/99_catalyst-synthesis.md, §§1–4].
